text_excerpt: In this section we explain a general procedure for producing the sites we will be working with. Suppose we want to study sheaves over schemes with respect to some topology $\tau$. In order to get a site, as in Sites, Definition \ref{sites-definition-site}, of schemes with that topology we have to do some work.
